Nadia Park: Quick sync: I sketched a compact-ledger + reconciler approach to replace the two-phase ownership handshake. Main goals: remove cross-service races, keep provenance, and give consumers one final reconciled stream.
Carlos Mendez: TL;DR of the flow?
Nadia Park: Ingest writes a small canonical event to ledger (write-once). If anything changes later (refunds, corrections) we append small correction records. Periodic reconciler runs fold ledger + corrections into per-window effective charges and emits a proof-bundle. Consumers read the reconciled stream for billing.
Riya Shah: How do we guarantee at-most-once apply for corrections?
Nadia Park: Each correction has a correction_id and references canonical_event_id. Reconciler keeps an applied-corrections index (TTL) and applies deltas idempotently. Ingest dedup still protects against producer retries.
Carlos Mendez: Auditability?
Nadia Park: Proof-bundle includes: window_id, reconciled_event_ids, signed list of ledger_refs. Auditors can fetch ledger slices referenced by those refs. We also include producer_trace and nonce in ledger rows for traceability.
Riya Shah: Minimal ledger row example?
Nadia Park: ```json
{"event_id":"e_abc123","tenant_id":"t_9","ts":"2026-03-20T12:00:00Z","kind":"usage","tokens":120,"producer":"runtime-3","nonce":"n_789","correction_of":null}
```
Carlos Mendez: Migration plan?
Nadia Park: 1) Dual-write canonical ledger + current handshake output. 2) Run reconciler in shadow mode, publish proof-bundles to compare topic. 3) Onboard billing consumer to reconciled stream. 4) Flip consumers gradually, then retire old path.
oncall-bot: note: add reconciliation-lag alert (normal < 5m).

Riya Shah: Ops notes: add forced-window-replay endpoint and reconciler health panel. Also we should cap how much backlog a single reconciler can accept to avoid OOMs on backfills.
Carlos Mendez: Cost tradeoffs? Storage for corrections + reconciler CPU. But simpler ingest path and fewer cross-service retries should lower overall ops cost.
Nadia Park: I'll draft RFC with schema, migration checklist, acceptance tests, and a short playbook. Tagging infra/product next. Thanks! :rocket:
